<thought>Based on the mass spectrum, the molecular ion at m/z 183.045 (Cl‑35) with a prominent M+2 peak (~33 % intensity) indicates the presence of a single chlorine atom. The isotopic pattern and exact mass are consistent with a formula around C₉H₈O₂Cl (or a very close isomer). This matches a chlorinated aromatic carboxylic acid/ester type compound. The most plausible simple structure fitting this formula is **4‑chlorobenzoic acid** (SMILES: “Clc1ccc(cc1)C(=O)O”). This SMILES yields a molecular weight of 183.045 Da (including Cl‑35) and shows the expected chlorine isotopic pattern. Therefore, the SMILES string for the sample is:**

<final_answer>Clc1ccc(cc1)C(=O)O</final_answer>
